task_instance: Design a new versioned REST API for a 'products' catalog resource following the skill's principles (resource-oriented plural-noun collections, URL versioning, correct HTTP method/status-code semantics, pagination + filtering, standardized structured error responses, built-in OpenAPI docs), implement it with FastAPI, run it, and verify the endpoints behave as designed.
evidence: Read SKILL.md plus its references (details.md, rest-best-practices.md, graphql-schema-design.md) and the FastAPI asset template. Created a venv in the work dir and installed fastapi, uvicorn, pydantic[email], httpx (fastapi 0.162.0). Wrote products_api.py implementing the skill's REST patterns: /api/v1/products collection (GET list with page/page_size/status/search filtering, POST create) and /api/v1/products/{product_id} item (GET/PATCH/DELETE), with a standardized ErrorResponse model and an HTTPException handler. verify.py drives the app through FastAPI's TestClient and asserts every design behaviour; all 11 checks passed: GET empty collection -> 200 with pagination metadata; POST -> 201 with generated uuid and timestamps; GET by id -> 200; GET missing -> 404 with structured {error,message,details[].code=not_found}; POST negative price -> 422 validation; filtering by status -> 1 item; search filter -> 1 item; page_size=1 -> pages=2; PATCH partial update -> 200; DELETE -> 204 then subsequent GET -> 404; OpenAPI spec generated with both resource paths and delete/get/patch methods on the item path. Also booted a live uvicorn server (products_api.py) on loopback port 8000: the generated OpenAPI JSON returned 200 (title 'Products API' v1.0.0), a live POST returned 201, and the interactive docs page returned 200. Deliverables in work dir: products_api.py, verify.py, openapi.json (generated spec, 2 paths), server.log. No external services, credentials, or MCP/connector tools were used.
